# Data Integrity Checklist: Pilot Evidence Surfaces

**Purpose**: Validate data-integrity requirements for SPEC-009E task evidence source references, stored-proof boundaries, negative evidence states, and retained SPEC-009D packet traceability.
**Created**: 2026-05-20
**Feature**: specs/009e-pilot-evidence-surfaces/spec.md

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are source-map requirements complete for stored `tasks`, `task_artifacts`, `quality_reviews`, governance rows, GitHub sync rows, packet/source-map references, and smoke checklist references? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-026, Data Model §Source Map Entry]
- [ ] CHK002 Are source references specified for every v1 response section, including `task`, `pilot_eligibility`, `identity`, `packet_artifacts`, `smoke`, `current_stage`, `warnings`, `deferrals`, and `source_map`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Data Model §Section-by-Section V1 State Matrix]
- [ ] CHK003 Are local-only, non-pilot, no-evidence, and partial-proof tasks required to stay `not_eligible`, `missing`, or `incomplete` rather than becoming proven pilot evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK004 Are retained SPEC-009D packet artifact references traceable by safe artifact id, artifact hash, packet/source-map reference, or static UAT link without inlining artifact content? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-021, Data Model §Review Packet Reference]
- [ ] CHK005 Are warning and missing-proof reason requirements complete for incomplete, conflicting, stale, unavailable, superseded, malformed, oversized, unsafe, and secret-bearing evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK006 Are cleaned disposable UAT rows represented through archived proof and cleanup rationale rather than current live Mission Control row claims? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030, Spec §FR-031]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the difference between source-map evidence, packet artifact references, retained GitHub issue/PR identity, static UAT links, and cleanup notes clear enough for implementers to avoid mixing source types? [Clarity, Data Model §Source Map Entry, Contract §SourceMapEntry]
- [ ] CHK008 Are source-map entry fields clear about `section`, `source_type`, `source_id`, `state`, and safe explanatory `note` content? [Clarity, Data Model §Source Map Entry, Contract §SourceMapEntry]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the stored-source hierarchy explicit enough that current task/activity rows win for live stage and identity while packet snapshots remain trace or warning evidence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026, Data Model §Current Stage Evidence]
- [ ] CHK010 Are retained issue #50 / PR #51 references clearly framed as archived pilot-trail proof when no live retained task row exists? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK011 Are SPEC-009D packet-local states and SPEC-009E v1 evidence states mapped clearly enough to avoid leaking `local_only_excluded`, `oversized`, or `malformed` as unsupported top-level eligibility states? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, Data Model §Allowed Evidence States]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do the spec, data model, and OpenAPI contract agree on allowed `source_type` values for task, activity, artifact, packet, quality review, governance, GitHub sync, retained GitHub issue/PR, static UAT link, and cleanup note references? [Consistency, Data Model §Source Map Entry, Contract §SourceMapEntry]
- [ ] CHK013 Do packet reference requirements consistently preserve safe metadata such as `artifact_id`, `sha256`, `mime_type`, `size_bytes`, and timestamps while excluding storage URIs, object paths, signed URLs, raw secrets, parser internals, and actor identity? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-028, Data Model §Review Packet Reference]
- [ ] CHK014 Do smoke evidence requirements consistently forbid runtime parsing of `docs/qa/pilot-smoke-checklist.md` while allowing stored packet/source-map references and static UAT links? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-029, Data Model §Smoke Checklist Evidence]
- [ ] CHK015 Do negative proof requirements align with SPEC-009D precedent that local-only and partial-proof candidates must remain excluded or incomplete instead of being presented as proven pilot evidence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, SPEC-009D §FR-013, SPEC-009D §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK016 Do source-map requirements align with HTTP/read-only boundaries so a `GET` can expose stored proof references without refreshing GitHub, generating packets, mutating artifacts, or writing audit/activity rows? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-027, Plan §Read-Only State Management Constraints]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Can SC-005 be objectively evaluated by checking that stored proof, missing proof, and deferred categories are distinguishable through API states plus source-map pointers? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005, Data Model §V1 Evidence State Model]
- [ ] CHK018 Can SC-002 be objectively evaluated with local-only and partial-proof fixtures that name at least one missing proof reason and never upgrade to eligible without stored proof? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK019 Can SC-004 be objectively evaluated by tracing the browser journey back to retained issue #50 / PR #51 evidence plus SPEC-009D packet/source-map and smoke-checklist references? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK020 Can reviewers objectively verify that every retained SPEC-009D packet artifact visible in SPEC-009E is traceable by id or hash rather than by terminal output or unstored local context? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001, Data Model §Review Packet Reference]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are conflicting stored source scenarios covered with warning/source-map behavior instead of silently choosing a misleading positive evidence state? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK022 Are stale, superseded, unavailable, quarantined, redacted, malformed, oversized, unsafe, and secret-bearing artifact evidence scenarios covered without counting unsafe or trace-only references as current proof? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK023 Are missing packet-only smoke proof, smoke-only packet proof, and unavailable artifact storage scenarios covered as incomplete or unavailable section states with specific source-map or warning evidence? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK024 Are long packet names, GitHub references, source-map pointers, warning reason codes, and deferred labels covered so data-integrity references remain readable and accessible without losing category association? [Coverage, Spec §FR-033, Spec §FR-034]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Are assumptions documented that existing stored task, artifact, activity, packet, smoke, GitHub identity, review, and governance records are sufficient data sources for v1 task evidence? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK026 Are dependencies on SPEC-009D packet/source-map semantics documented as read-only inputs rather than a call to `buildPilotReviewPacket()` or a new packet-generation path? [Dependency, Spec §FR-027, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK027 Are dependencies on existing artifact redaction, quarantine, supersession, and hash metadata documented as inherited safety boundaries for task evidence? [Dependency, Spec §FR-028, Data Model §Review Packet Reference]
